story: Stage 4 kicked off with an intense fight for the formation of the breakaway. Due to the continuously fast pace in the bunch all groups that formed were reeled back in quickly. After the first intermediate sprint a group of 5 formed. XDS Astana took control in the peloton and brought the breakaway back before the final climb. At the start of the uphill finish Alessandro Fancellu set a fierce tempo which reduced the group to around 5 riders. Within the final KM Guillermo Thomas Silva attacked on the flat section and quickly got a decisive gap on the chasers. Silva won solo ahead of Pesenti and Fancellu.
